blurb: Agni Yoga offers various yoga classes including hot yoga, Iyengar yoga wall classes, warm vinyasa flow, fascia focus, and breathwork sessions. Classes are held in SE Portland with options for memberships, class passes, and drop-ins. New students have introductory offers and must preregister for classes.
